definition.simple: A group of similar cells that work together like a team to do a specific job in the body.
definition.academic: A group of cells similar in structure that work together to achieve a particular function.

examples: Xylem tissue in plants transports water.

common_misconceptions: Thinking all tissues are identical (they vary greatly depending on their function).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Use the analogy of a school: students are cells, classes are tissues, and the school is the organism.
